d:
Arjit singh with another awsome track pal ak pal.
Presenting the year’s most romantic and soulful track – Pal , voiced by none other than Arijit Singh & Shreya Ghoshal.
Starring Varun Mitra and Rhea Chakraborty, the song has been composed by Javed – Mohsin.
A Vishesh Films Production in association with Mahesh Bhatt, Jalebi releases on the 12th of October,2018.
Director : Pushpdeep Bhardwaj
Banner : Vishesh Films in association with Mahesh Bhatt
Music : Javed - Mohsin
Singers : Arijit Singh & Shreya Ghoshal
